name_cn: 1029—领域内部与混合表征的主要子空间
hook: model.layers[l] forward output residual-post, zero-based; before final model.norm
dtype: native BF16 LM and A22 GEMM; captured FP32; analysis FP64
checks: All 384 final targets compared to R07 saved vectors; no extra texts or replay forward. First two targets check native CC forward vs existing threshold formula offline.

pca.fit: discovery only, domain-centered math/bio, pooled-centered mixture; sample denominator n; equal families, versions, domains

resampling.unit: family; all domain/wording/ending rows travel together
resampling.interval: split 2.5–97.5 percentiles describe partition sensitivity, not independent sampling CI; family-bootstrap refits yield pointwise 95% intervals
resampling.cross_split: math A vs biology B and math B vs biology A averaged; same disjoint family halves as same-domain comparisons

umap.fit: discovery only; development and exposed heldout transformed separately
umap.zero: exclude only nonfinite or zero-norm vectors, retain index and reason

inference: same existing local resource and padded1x256 as R07; native A22 normalized 14-layer inputs padded to encoder batch1024, learned threshold unchanged; no new tasks/resources/training
decision: continuous exploratory estimates, no invented universal overlap threshold or formal significance tests. Large same-domain variability prevents a confident different-space claim. Report full-sample and matched-half results separately; no equivalence claim from overlap of intervals.
authorization: Explicit current user task authorizes new PCA/UMAP fits and necessary fixed-text forward supplementation. No LM/dictionary/classifier/router training or feature clustering.
